chunk_list: NEXUS DATA ENGINEERING RECRUITMENT AND ONBOARDING PLAN V1.0 Purpose This plan defines recruitment and onboarding of a data engineer supporting ARIADNA, LUMEN, VERDANT, and shared infrastructure. The position has an initial duration of twelve months, with possible extension subject to funding and evaluation. Need The group maintains pipelines, indexes, APIs, bilingual data, and validation processes requiring stable engineering capacity. The recruited person does not replace scientific or legal responsibilities. The main role is to turn approved rules into reproducible, observable, and documented processes. Profile Experience with Python, SQL, version control, testing, containers, and data processing is required. Experience with graphs, search, multilingual processing, CI/CD, and basic Linux administration is valued. Written communication and the ability to document decisions are essential requirements. Process Selection covers requirements review, publication, shortlisting, a technical exercise, structured interview, references, and decision. Every applicant receives the same criteria. Conflicts of interest are declared. Notes and personal data are retained only for the authorized period. Onboarding The first week covers accounts, security, repositories, Atlas-2, environments, and projects. The first month includes one supervised task in each relevant line. Access to real data is granted after training and approval.
